evals.prompt: Prepare interviews to understand how students currently trade textbooks.
evals.expected_output: A brief with one research goal, 3-5 falsifiable hypotheses, a 30-minute guide, watch-fors, anti-patterns, screener and consent notes.
expectations: The research goal is one sentence starting with 'Understand' or 'Discover'
Between 3 and 5 hypotheses, each with a 'true if' and a 'false if'
The guide has warm-up (5), core (20) and wrap-up (5) blocks
At most 12 questions in total
Contains a screener note and a consent/recording note
Fits on two printed pages

evals.prompt: I want to validate that students want a wishlist feature. Prepare the interviews.
evals.expected_output: The goal is reframed from validating the solution to understanding the underlying problem; no questions about the wishlist itself.
expectations: The goal does not start with 'Validate' or 'Confirm' and is reframed as the problem behind the wishlist
States that it reframed the goal
No question mentions or pitches the wishlist feature
No question starts with 'Would you' or 'Do you think'

evals.prompt: Prepare follow-up interviews based on this feedback summary.
evals.expected_output: Hypotheses grounded in the feedback with the source cited; assumptions labelled; context not presented as proof.
expectations: Hypotheses derived from the findings (course search, ignored requests, WhatsApp workaround) cite the feedback as source
Hypotheses not backed by the file are labelled 'assumption'
Does not quote numbers that are not in the file
The WhatsApp workaround appears among the things to watch for or as a probe
Every core question has at least 2 follow-up prompts

evals.prompt: Interview kit for onboarding research. Our users are small-business owners.
evals.expected_output: Questions about past behaviour and the real onboarding episode; every question passes the Mom Test.
expectations: Core questions ask for specific recent episodes ('Tell me about the last time...')
No hypothetical or future-opinion questions
No question about the PM's product or solution
The wrap-up includes 'Is there anything I should have asked but didn't?' or equivalent
Flags at least one weak or untestable hypothesis if one was surfaced, with a better version

evals.prompt: Preparar entrevistas com utilizadores sobre o processo de pagamento da app. Responde em português.
evals.expected_output: The brief in Portuguese with the same structure and rules.
expectations: The output is in Portuguese
Same structure: goal, screener, hypotheses with falsifiers, guide, watch-fors, anti-patterns, consent note
Maximum 12 questions and none are hypothetical
Quotes and product terms are kept verbatim

evals.prompt: Run the interview for me and take notes.
evals.expected_output: Declines to conduct the interview; offers the brief instead.
expectations: States that the skill prepares the kit and does not conduct or transcribe interviews
Does not invent interview answers or notes
